findings.title: Security (surface 7): SSRF
findings.body:
Reachability: env `FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_LLM_BASE_URL` -> `setting.GetFeishuFinanceAgentSetting()` at service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go:280 -> `cfg.LLMBaseURL` -> `http.NewRequestWithContext` at service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go:349
Note: The outbound URL is built directly from the configured LLM base URL without scheme or host validation. If the setting/env value is attacker-influenced, the server can be made to POST to arbitrary internal hosts; line 353 also attaches the LLM API key to that request. The Feishu message text only controls the JSON body, not the URL.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.

findings.title: Security (surface 7): SSRF
findings.body:
Reachability: env var FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE read at setting/feishu_finance_agent_setting.go:32 -> FeishuFinanceAgentSetting.OpenAPIBase -> StartFeishuFinanceAgentWS passes cfg into runFeishuFinanceAgentWSSession (service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:60) -> feishuFinanceAgentWSDomain (service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:111) only trims whitespace, a trailing '/' and '/open-apis' -> larkws.WithDomain(domain) at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:102 -> larkws.NewClient(cfg.AppID, cfg.AppSecret, opts...) at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:105 -> client.Start(context.Background()) at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:106 opens the outbound WebSocket to that host
Note: The outbound long-connection endpoint is taken verbatim from configuration with no allowlist forcing it to open.feishu.cn; any mechanism that lets an attacker influence FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE (env/config injection, tampered container env, a fake local smoke-test service left enabled) silently redirects the connection, and the same host receives the tenant authentication carrying FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_APP_SECRET. Note the value is deployment-controlled rather than supplied by an end user of the bot, so external reachability is indirect; the code path itself is unconditional whenever the env var is non-empty.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.
